d: In a unanimous vote, Brooke was sent to jury villa, leaving Mo, Sharn and David to battle it out as the final three in Australian Survivor All Stars.

Nico Panagio returns again for yet another Season of Survivor this time he brings 21 castaways from all walks of life to the beautiful island nation of Samoa. The castaways are divided into 3 tribes: Ta'alo  Laumei and Sa'ula.

After Tribal Council, Steffi welcomes Seipei into "The Amigos". Tania rubs her tribe off in the wrong way, budding heads with Felix over turf under the tribe shelter. In Laumei, Rocco continues to broker conversations about an all-male alliance with Mike.
In this episode of Survivor, Sa'ula returns to their beach still reeling from the blindside that saw Paul being voted out of the game.
Twists and turns ensue when the game puts a span in the works for the 18 castaways in the form of a tribe swap causing a shift in alliances.
On this episode of Survivor, Nathan contemplates throwing a challenge to get rid of Geoff all to Steffi's dismay.
